# pvecli cluster

Manage cluster.

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`preflight`](preflight.md) | Check what silently breaks a cluster join or a maintenance window. |
| [`health`](health.md) | Quorum, node votes, HA and Ceph state in one view. |
| [`create`](create.md) | Turn the node of this profile into the first member of a new cluster. |
| [`join`](join.md) | Make a standalone node join the cluster of the current profile. |
| [`status`](status.md) | Show cluster status. |
| [`resources`](resources.md) | Show cluster resources. |
| [`usage`](usage.md) | Show cluster usage: node load, guest workload, overhead, pools, storage. |
| [`tasks`](tasks.md) | Show cluster tasks. |
| [`shutdown`](shutdown.md) | Shutdown the entire cluster (all nodes). |
| [`reboot`](reboot.md) | Reboot the entire cluster (all nodes). |
| [`ha`](ha.md) | Arm or disarm the whole HA stack (PVE 9.2+). |
| [`guests`](guests.md) | Start, shut down, suspend or migrate many guests in one go. |
| [`firewall`](firewall.md) | Manage the firewall of the datacenter. |
